title: EE60033: Digital Signal Processing
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Short introduction -Discrete time systems and signals; Z-transform, Difference
equation.
Filter design by transformation - Impulse and step Invariant, Bi-linear Ztransform, matched Z-transform.
Signal Model-AR, MA, ARMA, State Variable model, Lattice structures.
FIR filter design, Frequency windowing technique, Equi ripple Chebyshev and
Butterworth criterion.
Filter performance and design in presence of noise, FIR filters banks-subband
decomposition.
Inverse filtering-Deconvolution and equalization techniques-Weiner, Linear
prediction etc., Signal reconstruction.
Time frequency Analysis - STFT, WT, DSP hardware - Design methodologies,
Popular architectures and overview of programming Application notes.
Filter implementation: Topology, Scaling, Coefficient quantization, Signal
quantization, Sensitivity analysis.
